street: Stockholm, seen up close: rain, escalators, benches and the people who pass through them. One frame from Rome.
light-and-shadow: Single figures, deep blacks and one source of light.
places: Swedish landscape from the west coast to Jämtland, from open sky to still water.
architecture: Buildings and interiors in Stockholm and Uppsala, with people only for scale.
istria: Rovinj and Pula, July 2025. Stone alleys, shutters and the Adriatic in a strong wind.
